# svelte-stageshow

> A complete Svelte 5 port of Stageshow, Benji Taylor's MIT kit for framed faux
> product UI: a believable interface, cropped with intent, as one still or a short
> scripted demo. 69 scenes, the kit's 42 stylesheets carried over unchanged, his 44 brand
> marks, and no React at runtime.

It is a port, not an original. The design language, kit and scenes are Benji
Taylor's; the Svelte implementation is the port. Licence: MIT, notices kept.

## Docs

- [Docs](https://svelte-stageshow.vercel.app/docs/): install, quick start, the Stage and Window props, every
  exported component, looks and design tokens.
- [Landing page](https://svelte-stageshow.vercel.app/): what it is and what is verified.

## Components

Stage sets the design size and scales to its container. Window draws the chrome.
Also exported: Bar, Text, Phone, Row, Avatar, Chip, Cursor, StillProvider, and
motion parts (Count, Roll, Swap, Collapse, Fly, Follow, States, Stream, Popover,
Camera, Scroll, Expand), parts (BrandMark, Check, Facepile, Icon, Menu, Meter,
Pin, Spinner, Toast, Tooltip), controls (Badge, Field, Segmented, Slot, Tabs,
Toggle), and modules (Code, Chart, Keyboard, Thread, Bubble, Stamp, Receipt,
Prompt, Caret, LockScreen, Notification).

## Scenes

All 69 scenes are working components, each at https://svelte-stageshow.vercel.app/scenes/<slug>:

ai-cards, ai-chat, annotations, backgrounds, bento, brand-marks, calendar, chart-scrub, choreography, chrome, close-up, controls, corner-chip, cursor-morph, cursor-resize, cursors, dark-bento, dark-hero, device-pair, dynamic-island, excel, fade-crop, figma, finder, finder-glass, form-error, freeform-drag, glass, gmail, google-calendar, google-docs, hero-demo, hero-grid, imessage, kit-extras, linear, loading, looks, many-of-one, messages, monochrome, notion, opposite-corners, overlap, panel-annotation, parts, payout-flow, phone-touch, phones, powerpoint, presence, raycast, reorder, ruled-bento, share, slack, spotify, stacked-cards, staggered-bento, static-card, story, subscriptions, swipe, table-edit, telegram, tilted-stack, upload, wikipedia, window-row

## Verification

Each scene was rendered at a named settled mark in its own Act script and
compared against Benji's own output: 71 comparisons, 71 matched. The acceptance
table is in the repository.

## Source

- Repository: https://github.com/maven-ammar/svelte-stageshow
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/svelte-stageshow (pnpm add svelte-stageshow)
- Agent skill: npx skills add maven-ammar/svelte-stageshow --skill stageshow
- Upstream: https://benji.org/stageshow
